```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(trend)
```

``` {r load data}

# Load files directly downloadable from EDI repo. EDI: https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/fb1e48b0f1ed10857f5ffd842929274d. 
data <- read_csv("D:/Dropbox/projects/OhioRiver_SR-main//CHOIR_RiverSR_pred.csv")
centerlines <- read_sf("D:/Dropbox/projects/OhioRiver_SR-main/NHD_Centerlines/NHD_Centerlines.shp")

```

# Figure 5: Count of Observations and Mean Chlorophyll Concentration
```{r fig 5}

# Calculate reach mean concentration and count of observations
data_groupCOMID <- data %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(COMID)%>% 
  dplyr::summarize(count=n(),
            mean = mean(pred))

# Join centerlines to dataframe
data_groupCOMID <- merge(data_groupCOMID, centerlines, by="COMID", all.x=TRUE)
data_groupCOMID <- st_as_sf(data_groupCOMID)

# Create plots
count_plot <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data_groupCOMID, mapping=aes(col=count), linewidth=1.5)+
  labs(col="Number of Observations")+
  scale_color_viridis(option="A")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
count_plot

mean_plot <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data_groupCOMID, mapping=aes(col=mean), linewidth=1.5)+
  labs(col="Chlorophyll- a mean (ug/L)")+
  scale_color_viridis()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
mean_plot
```

# Figure 6: Time Series Plot Sample
```{r fig 6}
data$year <- format(as.Date(data$date, format="%Y-%m-%d"),"%Y")
data$year <- as.numeric(data$year)
data <- data %>% filter(year>1984)

# To demonstrate a sample of increasing trends select COMIDs 10357898/3370264/19453135 in the Ohio River
OhioRiver1_annualmean <- data%>%
  dplyr::filter(COMID==10357898)%>%
  dplyr::group_by(year)%>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean=mean(pred))

OhioRiver2_annualmean <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(COMID==3370264)%>%
  dplyr::group_by(year)%>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean=mean(pred))

OhioRiver3_annualmean <- data %>%
  dplyr::filter(COMID==19453135)%>%
  dplyr::group_by(year)%>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean=mean(pred))

OhioRiver_annual <- ggplot()+
  geom_line(OhioRiver1_annualmean, mapping=aes(x=year, y=mean), col='lightgrey', alpha=0.8, linewidth=1)+
  geom_line(OhioRiver2_annualmean, mapping=aes(x=year, y=mean), col='#515151', alpha=0.8, linewidth=1)+
  geom_line(OhioRiver3_annualmean, mapping=aes(x=year, y=mean), col='black', alpha=0.8, linewidth=1)+
  xlab("Year")+
  ylab("Chl-a Conc. (ug/L)")+
  labs(title="Ohio River")+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=14))
OhioRiver_annual

OhioRiver1_slope_annual <- sens.slope(OhioRiver1_annualmean$mean)$estimates
OhioRiver2_slope_annual <- sens.slope(OhioRiver2_annualmean$mean)$estimates
OhioRiver3_slope_annual <- sens.slope(OhioRiver3_annualmean$mean)$estimates

OhioRiver_meanslope <- mean(c(OhioRiver1_slope_annual, OhioRiver2_slope_annual, OhioRiver3_slope_annual))
```
